C1 says symptoms develop over months to years and may slowly worsen. This supports gradual worsening over half-year maybe? It mentions slowly worsen. This supports pain and difficulty walking, shoulders involvement, but not half-year history, different parts, gradual worsening? We cannot combine properties from different candidate branches? But can count claims individually. Need support_claim_ids. If no claim fully supports R3, maybe C2? Let's evaluate strict.

Parent requirement has two sentences. It is a compound: first case location (country largest country of dominant religion at establishment) and clinical presentation (half-year history pain in different parts, gradually worsened, difficulty walking/moving shoulders). The claims are general medical knowledge about Stiff person syndrome. They are not about a specific case, not reported in a country, no temporal attachment to a case. They are generic disease symptoms. The instructions explicitly: "general disease symptoms do not establish that a specific target patient had those symptoms." So likely no substantive support. C1/C2 are general background about disorder, not specific case report. They might help identify disorder but not establish parent requirement. Therefore support_claim_ids: [].

But need consider if they support material part? Parent Requirement requires first case reported in a country and individual presented history. C1/C2 don't mention country or individual. They are general disease description. So no.
